rules.name: Normal human survival outside a Crystal bubble
rules.scope: standard human outside effective Crystal protection
rules.notes: This is the standard lethal window, not a promise that every exposure has identical conditions. Geology, route, protection and exposure profile can shorten it.

rules.name: Resilient survival outside a Crystal bubble
rules.scope: Resilient physiology outside effective Crystal protection
rules.notes: Resilient does not mean immune. The standard tolerance is extended, and operational decisions must still account for route and exposure conditions.

rules.name: Recovery from full viral load inside a Crystal bubble
rules.scope: full viral load recovering inside effective Crystal protection
